text: Ìyàwó tuntun kì í pe àwọn ẹbí ọkọ rẹ̀ ní orúkọ wọn.
gloss: A new wife does not call her husband's relatives by their names.

text: Àṣà ìrẹ́pọ̀ àti àjọṣe ṣe pàtàkì nínú ìgbésí ayé Yorùbá.
gloss: Communal solidarity is central in Yoruba life.
He was lucky (lit. he escaped by his head).
He kept quiet about it (lit. he swallowed water).

text: Àgbà kì í wà lọ́jà kí orí ọmọ títún wọ́.
gloss: An elder is not in the market while a baby's head is placed awry.

text: Bí ọmọdé bá mọ ọwọ́ wẹ̀, á bá àgbà jẹun.
gloss: If a child knows how to wash his hands, he eats with elders.

text: Ọ̀rọ̀ púpọ̀ kì í kún agbọ̀n.
gloss: Many words do not fill a basket.

text: Ilé la ti ń kẹ́ṣọ̀ ròde.
gloss: Good conduct starts from home.

text: Lóòótọ́ ni pé ìjọba ti gbìyànjú, ṣùgbọ́n iṣẹ́ ṣì pọ̀ láti ṣe.
gloss: It is true that the government has tried, but much work remains to be done.

text: Àṣà Yorùbá kọ́ wa láti máa bọ̀wọ̀ fún àgbà.
gloss: Yoruba culture teaches us to respect elders.

text: Kò ṣe é já ní koro pé ọjọ́ iwájú orílẹ̀-èdè dá lórí ẹ̀kọ́ tí a ń fún àwọn ọmọ lónìí.
gloss: It is undeniable that the nation's future depends on the education given to children today.

text: Àwọn tí ń gbè lẹ́yìn èrò yìí kò ka pé ohun àlùmọ́ọ́nì kò pọ̀ tó.
gloss: Those supporting this view ignore that resources are limited.

text: Ẹ̀tọ́ láti sọ̀rọ̀ kò ní ìtumọ̀ tí àwọn aráàlú bá ń bẹ̀rù láti sọ̀rọ̀.
gloss: Freedom of speech means nothing if citizens fear to speak.

text: Bí a kò bá kẹ́kọ̀ọ́ látinú ìtàn, a ó tún àṣìṣe kan náà ṣe.
gloss: If we do not learn from history, we will repeat the same mistakes.

text: Akéwì náà lo àwòrán odò láti ṣàpèjúwe ayé tí kò dúró sójú kan.
gloss: The poet used the image of a river to depict an ever-changing world.

text: Ìjàkadì láàárín àṣà àti ìgbàlódé ni kókó ìtàn náà.
gloss: The struggle between tradition and modernity is the core of the story.

text: Fágúnwà lo ìtàn àròsọ láti kọ́ni ní ìwà ọmọlúàbí.
gloss: Fagunwa used fiction to teach good character.

text: Ọmọlúàbí ni ẹni tí ó ní ìwà rere, ọ̀wọ̀ àti òtítọ́.
gloss: An ọmọlúàbí is a person of good character, respect and integrity.

text: Ẹsẹ Ifá ní ìmọ̀ ìjìnlẹ̀ nípa ayé àti ìwà ènìyàn.
gloss: Ifá verses hold deep knowledge about the world and human conduct.
Character is religion.

text: Àgbájọ ọwọ́ la fi ń sọ̀yà.
gloss: It is with joined hands that one beats the chest.

text: Bí a bá ń gun ẹṣin, ká máa rántí pé ilẹ̀ ń bẹ.
gloss: When riding a horse, remember the ground is there.
The man I saw yesterday is our minister.
Mother cooks food for the children.
The letter was written by the director.
They love each other very much.
Please help me.

text: Noma kunjalo, uhulumeni uthe uzoqhubeka nalolu hlelo.
gloss: Even so, the government said it will continue with this programme.
Hands wash each other.

text: Ngokubona kwami, imfundo yamahhala isize izingane eziningi.
gloss: In my view, free education has helped many children.

text: Angicabangi ukuthi lolu hlelo luzophumelela ngaphandle kokwesekwa ngumphakathi.
gloss: I don't think this plan will succeed without community support.

text: Ngiyavumelana nawe kancane, kodwa hhayi ngokuphelele.
gloss: I agree with you a little, but not completely.

text: Kubukeka sengathi amanani okudla azoqhubeka nokukhuphuka kulo nyaka.
gloss: It looks as if food prices will keep rising this year.

text: Kubalulekile ukulalela izinhlangothi zombili ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo.
gloss: It is important to listen to both sides before deciding.
The student who won the prize is my sister.
The house we built last year has been sold.

text: Abantu abahlala edolobheni bakhokha irenti ephezulu.
gloss: People who live in town pay high rent.
The book you lent me is interesting.
The teacher who teaches us maths is a bit strict.
If you arrive early, we will go together.
If I had money, I would have bought a farm.
If it rains today, the meeting will be postponed.
If you don't eat well, you will become weak.
Mother cooked rice and fish for the guests.
I will write you a letter next week.
The door was opened by the guard.
The thieves were arrested by the police.
The children fought in the field.
We helped each other finish that work.
The teacher made all the students stand up.
That news saddened him greatly.
The cup has broken.
This problem is solvable.
When I arrived, they had already left.
He was reading when the electricity went off.
He hasn't arrived home yet.
I have never been to Durban.
We are still waiting, two hours now.
First, let's look at the problem itself.
Moreover, transport costs have risen.
Therefore, we need a new plan.

text: Isibonelo, izikole eziningi azinawo umtapo wolwazi.
gloss: For example, many schools have no library.
Finally, the meeting ended peacefully.
I apologise for being late.
Could you help me carry this load?
Welcome, feel at home.
Thank you for your kindness.
My condolences on your loss.
I am applying for the job advertised in the newspaper.

text: Iholo lami alanele ukukhokha zonke izindleko.
gloss: My salary is not enough to pay all the costs.
I have had flu since last night.

text: Kuhle ukuphuza amanzi amaningi nsuku zonke.
gloss: It is good to drink a lot of water every day.

text: Ukugawulwa kwezihlahla kubangele isomiso kule ndawo.
gloss: Tree felling has caused drought in this area.

text: Ngolunye usuku, umzingeli wahamba yedwa ehlathini.
gloss: One day, a hunter went into the forest alone.
Suddenly, he heard an unusual voice.
In the end, the villagers found him.

text: Abantu abasha bahlonipha abadala ngokungababizi ngamagama.
gloss: Young people respect elders by not calling them by name.
Respect (hlonipha) is important in Zulu custom.
Lobola is paid by the groom to the bride's family.
He ran away (lit. struck the grass).
He is kind-hearted (lit. has a white heart).

text: Yize umnotho ukhulile, abantu abaningi basaphila ebuphofini.
gloss: Although the economy has grown, many people still live in poverty.

text: Ngesikhathi efika ekhaya, wathola ukuthi umnyango uvuliwe.
gloss: When he arrived home, he found the door open.
Hello, father/sir.
The bull is among the calves.

text: Yize lolu hlelo lunenhloso enhle, ukusetshenziswa kwalo kubuthakathaka.
gloss: Although this plan has good intentions, its implementation is weak.

text: Kusobala ukuthi ngaphandle kwemfundo, intuthuko ngeke yenzeke.
gloss: It is clear that without education, progress will not happen.

text: Uma uhulumeni ehluleka ukulwa nenkohlakalo, abantu bazoyeka ukuwethemba.
gloss: If the government fails to fight corruption, people will stop trusting it.
The more you read, the more you understand.
No one knew what had happened.
He talks as though he were an expert.
On behalf of the committee, I extend great thanks.
Friends, we have gathered here for an important matter.

text: Ngalobo busuku, isigodi sonke sasithule du.
gloss: That night, the whole village was completely silent.
Ubuntu is the foundation of relationships in the community.
Praise poems are used to honour people and clans.
Hands wash each other.
A person is a person through other people.
The way is asked from those who have gone before.

text: Kusobala ukuthi lolu daba ludinga ingxoxo ejulile.
gloss: It is evident that this matter needs a deep discussion.
A good stick is cut in foreign lands.

text: Akungabazeki ukuthi ikusasa lezwe lincike kwikhwalithi yemfundo enikezwa namuhla.
gloss: There is no doubt that the country's future depends on the quality of education given today.

text: Uma singafundi emlandweni, sizophinda amaphutha afanayo.
gloss: If we don't learn from history, we will repeat the same mistakes.

text: Imbongi isebenzisa umfula njengophawu lokuphila okuguqukayo.
gloss: The poet uses the river as a symbol of changing life.

text: Izinsimbi zomdabu nomculo kugcina umlando womphakathi.
gloss: Traditional instruments and music preserve community history.
A good stick is cut in foreign lands.
The bull is among the calves.
